newsitem.title: USA: Clear Channel files $1.5 bln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Clear Channel files $1.5 bln shelf.

text.p: Clear Channel Communications Inc filed Monday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register a shelf offering of up to $1.5 billion in debt securities, preferred stock, common shares, and warrants.
The preferred securities may be issued by special trusts affiliated with the company, according to the SEC filing.

Proceeds from the sale will be used by the diversified media company for general corporate purposes, including repaying outstanding debt, funding working capital needs, stock repurchases and acquisitions.
No underwriters were named in the shelf offering.
